whatIsIt.eli5: When many boxes point at the same thing, keep the best one and remove the copies.
whatIsIt.simple: Sorts the remaining boxes by score and removes any box that overlaps a better box of the same class by more than the IoU threshold (0.7 by default).
whatIsIt.engineer: Greedy per-class NMS on IoU; default iou = 0.7, max_det = 300. Runs outside the network graph.

whyExists.eli5: Neighbouring squares often find the same weed, so there would be many boxes for one weed.
whyExists.simple: With one-to-many training, several nearby cells learn to fire for the same object. NMS removes the duplicates.
whyExists.engineer: One-to-many label assignment yields redundant positives; NMS is the inference-time de-duplication step (latency depends on the number of boxes).

eli5: Remove boxes that mostly cover the same area.
Repeat with the next best box.
simple: Take the top box and keep it.
Delete others of the same class with IoU above the threshold.
Repeat until none are left or 300 are kept.
engineer: Complexity O(n²) in candidates; dense scenes (many weeds) make it slower and can suppress true neighbours.

tradeoffs.eli5: If weeds touch each other, this clean-up may remove a real one.
tradeoffs.simple: A higher IoU threshold keeps more touching objects but also more duplicates. NMS time grows with the number of boxes, which matters on small devices.
tradeoffs.engineer: Threshold trades duplicate suppression vs. crowded-object recall; NMS-free (end-to-end) heads avoid this step.
